notes: Physical platforms are distinct from coloured scorecard tees and daily marker placements. No colours, daily marker positions or adjusted playing-line distances are claimed.
No source absolute horizontal accuracy was reported. A 0.25m export pixel is not a 0.25m absolute accuracy certificate.
Only accepted complete visible new rings are adopted. Previously accepted H8/H9 rings are retained explicitly with their original provenance.

Both clean dated source crops and traced overlays were visually inspected. Raw imagery remains outside the repository; source requests, hashes and exact pixel/EPSG/local rings make each trace reviewable.
